text:
sina: Heads-up — eu-west1 is showing a sudden hotstripe IOPS burst on scratchpool and it's blocking GPU attaches. Seen this after the peering change earlier.
leo: Any error lines? Is this the same pool as yesterday?
sina: Logs show attach timeouts and high queue depth on local nvme:
```
attach: device attach timed out after 1800ms
nvme0: qos_queue_depth=2048 iops=68000
node=gn-eu-west1-901 attach_wait_ms=1850
```
priya: Paging in case it's creating elevated allocator backpressure. oncall-bot: paging priya.
ops-bot: Auto-created incident INC-2026-349 and notified SRE oncall.
leo: Quick thought — peering induced metadata flood could be triggering janitor/deep-scrub fanout on cold stripes. Can we temporarily reduce cleaner concurrency and pause rebalancer?
sina: I'm toggling scrub concurrency flags for eu-west1: `--cleaners=1 --scrub-window=120s` now.
priya: Also adding a k8s taint to avoid scheduling new GPU pods on affected nodes, routing to eu-west2/dedicated. Applying node-affinity update.
sina: Changes applied. Initial metric: local nvme IOPS dropped from 6x -> 1.6x baseline within 2m. Attach timeouts reduced.
leo: Good. Can we run a small fio canary on a quarantined node to verify no underlying device errors?
priya: Kicked off fio on gn-eu-west1-905:
```
fio --name=randrw --rw=randrw --rwmixread=30 --bs=32k --size=512M --numjobs=8 --runtime=60
```
priya: Results: no I/O errors, p95 latency ~3.1ms, throughput acceptable.
leo: That indicates load, not hardware failure. For medium-term: propose per-pool QoS caps and adaptive cleaner backoff tied to attach latency SLI. I'll file OPS ticket.
sina: Agreed. Also let's measure cost delta from routing ~40 extra GPUs to dedicated in last 30m. Priya — can you estimate?
priya: Quick calc: +40 GPUs * 0.6h * $2.5/hr ~= $60. Adding to ticket.
oncall-bot: INC-2026-349 status: mitigated.
leo: Thanks. Keep scrub concurrency low for 30m and then ramp slowly while monitoring attach p99.
sina: Will do. I'll draft a short postmortem and include recommended fixes: per-pool throttles, peering metadata rate limits, cleaner hysteresis, and emergency routing playbook.
priya: I'll follow up with the autoscaler change and OPS ticket OPS-5699: "hotstripe fanout after peering cutover — QoS and cleaner controls".
sina: Closing thread for now. We'll publish postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
